people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said, “You must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice to Yahweh our God.
translations.bsb: But Moses replied, “You must also provide us with sacrifices and burnt offerings to present to the LORD our God.
translations.kjv: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.
translations.asv: And Moses said, Thou must also give into our hand sacrifices and burnt-offerings, that we may sacrifice unto Jehovah our God.
